title: OSW ORLD: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
abstract: OSW ORLD is a benchmark for multimodal agents that can perform open-ended tasks in real computer environments. It provides a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating agents across various operating systems and applications. The benchmark consists of 369 real-world computer tasks, including web browsing, file management, and software development.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're working on a project and need to update a spreadsheet with recent transactions. You'd like an autonomous agent to help you with this task. But, how can we create such an agent that can interact with various applications and interfaces?

We introduce OSW ORLD, a real computer environment that supports task setup, execution-based evaluation, and interactive learning across different operating systems.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
OSW ORLD uses a virtual machine to create a safe and isolated environment for agents to interact with. The environment is configured through a config file that specifies the initial state, task setup, and evaluation scripts.

Agents can generate executable actions, such as mouse clicks and keystrokes, to interact with the environment.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We evaluated state-of-the-art LLM and VLM-based agents on OSW ORLD and found that they struggle to accomplish tasks, with the best model achieving only 12.24% success.

In contrast, humans can accomplish over 72.36% of the tasks.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
OSW ORLD provides a unified environment for evaluating open-ended computer tasks, allowing us to assess the capabilities of multimodal agents in a more realistic setting.

The benchmark reveals significant deficiencies in current LLM and VLM-based agents, highlighting the need for further research in this area.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
OSW ORLD introduces a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating multimodal agents, supporting task setup, execution-based evaluation, and interactive learning across different operating systems.

The benchmark consists of 369 real-world computer tasks, providing a comprehensive evaluation of agent capabilities.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
OSW ORLD is publicly available, allowing researchers to develop and evaluate their own multimodal agents.

The environment and benchmark can be accessed at https://os-world.github.io.
